messages:
maria: quick reminder — release cutoff is tomorrow 00:00 UTC. we still need the lockfile bump + vendor sync for the infra deps. please tag me on any prs you want prioritized.

alex: i'm landing the submodule update now (gcc-toolchain). will open a PR shortly, should be low risk but needs a smoke run.

sam: heads-up — when you update vendor/, run `scripts/vendor_sync.sh --sha` and then `make deps-lock` so CI picks up the new lockfile. last time someone forgot the lock regenerate and CI passed locally but failed in CI. :grimacing:

maria: thanks. can you also include the vendor tarball checksum in the commit message so release automation can validate? format: `vendor: add tarball sha256=<sha>`

alex: yup — PR will include:
```
* submodule: update gcc-toolchain to v1.4.2
* vendor: regenerate tarball & lockfile
* ci: add macOS retry for flaky test
```

ci-bot: dependabot created a PR 1968001122 to bump golang.org/x/crypto -> v0.0.0-2024xxxx. runs queued.

sam: @alex fyi there was a transient macOS flake on the runner during the last vendor smoke (test_http_timeouts). if you see a flaky failure, add `--rerun-failed` for the smoke script.

alex: good call. i'll include `--rerun-failed` to the smoke command in the PR description. also pinging @jen to see if release team wants to hold until we validate the golang bump from dependabot.

jen: let's prioritize the submodule + vendor sync first. if dependabot is only a minor security bump we can merge after a brief audit (1 dev). plan:
- merge alex's submodule PR after green smoke
- wait for vendor + lockfile to be regenerated in the same PR if possible
- if dependabot conflicts, open a follow-up tiny PR and schedule for next day cutoff window (no late risky changes)

maria: sounds good. also reminder to set the changelog snippet in the PR body: `CHANGELOG: deps: vendor and submodule updates` — product wants a one-liner per dependency group.

alex: PR is up: https://git.company/repo/pulls/4321 — includes vendor tarball, lockfile, and smoke steps. CI currently running (macOS queued). pls review when you can. :eyes:

sam: reviewing now. small nit: can you squash the vendor regen commits into one? keeps history cleaner.

alex: will squash in place if CI is green. thanks.

maria: if CI still flakes on mac runner, fallback plan is to run the smoke job locally in docker and upload the artifacts to the PR. if you need access to the release staging env, ping me and i'll grant temporary creds.

dependabot: automated audit passed for golang bump; no direct API surface change detected.

jen: thanks all. final ask: whoever merges, add the release label `rc/2026-03-17` so the cut tools pick it up. merge window closes at cutoff. :alarm_clock: :shipit:
